description: This file contains unit tests for safe reading operations on file handles, specifically testing reading to the end and reading up to a certain count, handling closed handles, and incremental reading from a pipe.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test methods verifying safe read operations for file handles.

methods.name: `read to end safely returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Tests that reading to the end from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: `read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to read up to a count from a closed handle results in empty data.

methods.name: `read to end safely reads pipe contents`
methods.description: Checks that reading to the end from a pipe retrieves the written data correctly.

methods.name: `read safely up to count reads incrementally`
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a count reads data in multiple chunks accurately.
